name: Methylenedioxypropargylamphetamine
summary: MDPL, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-propargylamphetamine or as N-propargyl-MDA, is a lesser-known drug and a substituted amphetamine.

fact.en: MDPL is MDA with a propargyl group on its nitrogen, a short chain with a triple bond. The same group appears in the Parkinson's drugs selegiline and rasagiline.
fact.zh: MDPL 是在 MDA 的氮原子上接一個炔丙基，也就是帶三鍵的短鏈。同樣的基團也出現在帕金森氏症藥物司來吉蘭與雷沙吉蘭中。
fact.zhHans: MDPL 是在 MDA 的氮原子上接一个炔丙基，也就是带三键的短链。同样的基团也出现在帕金森氏症药物司来吉兰与雷沙吉兰中。
